name: BCI Riemannian vs CNN benchmarking suite
description: A comparative benchmark that evaluates Riemannian-geometry-based methods and convolutional neural networks on EEG brain–computer interface datasets to compare classification performance and robustness.
reputation: Niche but recognized within the EEG/BCI research community for controlled comparisons between Riemannian and CNN approaches; not a universal standard.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; subject/session variability and small per-subject data sizes can limit generalization; results sensitive to preprocessing and cross-subject contamination risks.
